_comment: Optional overrides. Rename to burnmon.json next to burnmon.exe (or burnmon-cli.exe). Any subset of fields works; everything omitted keeps the compiled-in default. Values below are illustrative, not a real invoice: replace them with your own seat counts and invoice total.
_comment_books: v0.3 C1. Three dated, embedded price books, each overridable in part: naming one model keeps every other compiled-in model (same partial-merge behaviour as prices/subscription above). Recalibrate a book by editing its date, source and only the models that changed. Leave this whole block out to keep the compiled-in books as-is; the anthropic_book example below only shows re-dating one model, the rest of the book stays compiled-in.
_comment_copilot_plan: v0.3 C3/K3. Names the account's real GitHub Copilot plan tier, a key into copilot_credits.plans (see books/copilot_credits.json for the compiled-in tiers: Free, Pro, Pro+, Max). Only set once the account is actually on that plan; leave this key out to omit the "credits left" line entirely rather than guess a tier.
_comment_copilot_vscode_otel_file: v0.3 A4. The path GitHub Copilot Chat in VS Code writes its OpenTelemetry spans to (set github.copilot.chat.otel.enabled and github.copilot.chat.otel.outfile to the same path in VS Code's settings.json, then reload the VS Code window once so the exporter actually starts). Empty or absent means A4 is off: no polling, nothing shown for Copilot in VS Code. Example: "copilot_vscode_otel_file": "C:\\Users\\you\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\copilot-otel.jsonl".
_comment_owners: v0.2 P6, the light client map, extended in v0.3 K1 with an optional client and remote per rule. Empty (shown here) is the default: one owner, no owner or client column shown anywhere. Ordered rules, first match wins for owner (path only, unchanged since v0.2); client is resolved separately, a remote rule first (matched against the project's git origin remote, a case-insensitive substring of its URL), then a path rule, else "unassigned". Example: "owners": [{"match": "C:\\dev\\work\\*", "owner": "Acme"}, {"match": "C:\\dev\\side\\*", "owner": "Side", "client": "ClientA", "remote": "github.com/org/repo"}]. Applied at ingest; after changing the rules, re-apply them to sessions already in the store with `burnmon-cli reown`.
_comment_wsl: wsl_scan, extra_sources and wsl_interval_hours are new in v0.7.0. The three values below are shown at their defaults (auto-scan, nothing extra, 4-hour WSL cadence), so leaving this block out entirely is equivalent. Set wsl_scan to "off" if you do not want the app touching a WSL distro at all.
_comment_history: B1. keep_history (default true): a transcript deleted from disk keeps its events in the store and only its read position is forgotten. Set false to drop a vanished transcript's events on the next scan.
